identity.name: Kerberos Pre-Auth Failures via Password Spraying
identity.summary: An attacker performs password spraying using Kerberos pre-authentication failures to identify valid user accounts. Cortex detects this behavior via abnormal Kerberos pre-auth failure patterns by user
identity.description: An attacker performs password spraying using Kerberos pre-authentication failures to identify valid user accounts. Cortex detects this behavior via abnormal Kerberos pre-auth failure patterns by user and host. The attack involves multiple failed Kerberos authentications followed by successful logins.

payload.code: powershell -Command "Add-Type -AssemblyName System.DirectoryServices.AccountManagement; $context = New-Object System.DirectoryServices.AccountManagement.PrincipalContext([System.DirectoryServices.AccountManagement.ContextType]::Domain, 'TESTDOMAIN.LOCAL'); $users = @('user1', 'user2', 'user3'); foreach ($user in $users) { try { $result = $context.ValidateCredentials($user, 'weakpassword'); if ($result) { Write-Host "Valid user: $user" } else { Write-Host "Failed login attempt for user: $user" } } catch { Write-Host "Error validating user: $_" } }"

biocs.name: Kerberos Pre-Auth Failures by User and Host
biocs.description: Detects multiple Kerberos pre-authentication failures from a single host for different users, indicating credential spraying behavior
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK and event_sub_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.100' and dst_port = 88
| filter action_process_image_name = 'lsass.exe'
| comp count() as cnt by actor_process_image_name, action_remote_ip, dst_port
| comp count() as cnt by > 5
| comp 5m

abiocs.name: Kerberos Pre-Auth Failure Pattern
abiocs.description: Detects repeated Kerberos pre-auth failures from a single host for multiple distinct users, modeling credential spraying behavior
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK and event_sub_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.100' and dst_port = 88
| filter action_process_image_name = 'lsass.exe'
| comp count() as cnt by actor_process_image_name, action_remote_ip, dst_port
| comp count() as cnt by > 3
| comp 5m
